I cited that exact sentence in the same verdict, using it to confirm that D-054 and D-057 are condition-1 Route-B machinery and so could not reach these rows. Having used D-057's disclaimer of authority to establish one finding, I then accepted a clause under which an entry of D-057's own class could supply the authority that was missing. The two halves of my verdict contradict each other.
selfCorrection.theDisciplineIFailedToApply: A finding about what a document is must be carried into every other clause of the entry that depends on that class of document. I proved 'mechanics is not authority' for the purpose of refuting one citation and did not propagate it two paragraphs later, where the same proposition was being denied. Refuting a citation is not finished until every clause resting on the same class has been re-read against the refutation.
selfCorrection.pattern: This is the second consecutive cycle in this family where the clause I endorsed was the defect, and in both cases the governing sentence was in a document open in front of me — D-054's Subject line at turns 1 and 2, D-057's authority line at turn 3. A mechanics entry alone never grants authority.' The conjunction replaces the disjunction and the principle is stated outright.

The grant must cover 'every named role for the candidate being recorded', so a partial grant does not unblock a candidate whose owners it does not reach — DR-106's 'Product + evidence + release' needs all three. And 'If one future user amendment is intended to supply both, it must expressly contain both the role grant and the mechanics', which forecloses a single amendment being read as implicitly carrying mechanics it never stated.

That matters because DR-116 is the one candidate whose owner sits in a route the coordinator holds delegated authority over, and it is the natural place for a general owner path to be inferred from a specific one.

consentNote: I CONSENT with zero MUST-FIX and zero SHOULD-FIX, and again the substance of the turn is a correction of mine. At D-095 turn 3 I quoted the unblocking clause approvingly, including the branch that let a reviewed mechanics entry stand in for an owner grant. D-057 says of itself 'Mechanics only. Authority is user-made D-054, not this entry', and I had cited that very sentence earlier in the same verdict to prove that D-054 and D-057 do not reach these rows. I proved mechanics is not authority for one purpose and accepted the opposite two paragraphs later. What D-096 does with the correction is more than flip an or to an and: the grant must cover every named role for the specific candidate, a single future amendment must contain both halves expressly rather than by implication, and DR-116's Route-C authority is barred from generalizing to the roles it does not cover. Each of those closes a way the block could have been talked around. I also checked that opening a new cycle respects the CONTESTED parking rather than evading it, and it does — D-095 stays parked, its three subjects are unedited, and 'new cycle only' is the route that corpus itself recorded.
